answer.rationale: A release 2 hours ago combined with p99 latency climbing 5x over 90 minutes on the write path is the strongest temporal signal. memory_b1 demonstrates that rollback has historically cleared checkout error spikes without customer impact and completed cleanly. Since the degradation is confined to primary region and settlement is at peak, the release is the most actionable variable. A rollback is faster than capacity provisioning (which takes time) and more targeted than regional failover when the problem is localized. Verifying memory_b1 confirms rollback can execute cleanly under load. Circuit breakers and read replicas address symptom classes, not root cause here. Starting with rollback preserves the option to failover or add capacity if the rollback does not resolve the issue.
